name: Waltred Graf Von Ulfhedinn
original_name: ヴァルトレート・グラーフ・フォン・ウールヴヘジン
source:
A mysterious noble man with who lives alone with his servant, Dalim, in a mansion deep in the forest. He rarely goes down to the city and is the subject of rumors among people.

[Translated from [url=http://erfolg.main.jp/project/muh/]ERFOLG's official website[/url]]
